subject: 🩺 Reminder: your $screening_label is due on $due_date
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is a reminder that a health screening is coming up for you. Screenings are quick, routine and free to students — they are how we catch things early, while they are easy to treat.

=== YOUR SCREENING ===
Screening: $screening_type
Due Date: $due_date
$due_line
Reference: $screening_id
Student ID: $student_id
Provider: $provider

=== HOW TO BOOK ===
1. Log in to the Health Portal and choose Appointments, or
2. Call the Health Centre on (555) 123-4567, or
3. Drop in during open clinic hours.

Appointments usually take 15-20 minutes.

=== IF YOU HAVE ALREADY HAD THIS DONE ===
If you have had this screening elsewhere — at your GP, at home, or at another university — let us know and we will update your record so you stop receiving reminders. Send the date and where it was done to health@university.edu.

=== IF YOU DO NOT WANT THIS SCREENING ===
Screenings are offered, not required. If you would rather not have it, tell the Health Centre and we will note that on your record.

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Health Centre: health@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Best regards,
University Health Centre

$signature
